whatThisPluginAdds.text: Content Reveal adds a Layout Builder widget that presents teaser cards and reveals registered widget snapshots in modal, slideover, inline, or replacement modes. Reveal targets stay within the widget registry.

surfaceOutcome.text: Editors connect a teaser to another registered widget, and visitors can reveal that content without leaving the current public page.

developers.text: The extension declares interaction support and a widget target capability through a typed definition rather than accepting arbitrary render targets.

teams.text: Teams can keep supporting material available on demand while preserving a concise first view of the page.
